newsitem.title: UK: UK's Knight says PPI data "good news" on inflation.
newsitem.headline: UK's Knight says PPI data "good news" on inflation.

text.p: British Treasury economic secretary Angela Knight said Monday's August producer price numbers brought "good news" on the domestic inflation outlook.
"The first class run of August figures on the economy continues into September," Knight said in a statement, quoted by a Treasury spokesman.

"The fall in output and input inflation to very low levels gives British manufacturers even better opportunities to sell goods abroad and brings good news for the inflation outlook at home," Knight said.

August output prices were unchanged in the month and showed a 2.0 percent year-on-year rise, compared with a 2.2 percent year-on-year rate in July. Input prices rose 0.3 percent in the month and fell 2.2 percent in the year.
